units: <cite ref="Berakhot 58a">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>וכַבִּינְהוּ לעיניה</he> Ar. (Ms. M. <he>ונכבינהו</he>, corr. acc.; ed. <he>חברוהי כחלינהו וכ׳</he>) dimmed his eye-sight, v. <cite ref="B00228"><he>בּוֹטְטָא</he></cite>. Ib. 60ᵇ bot. <he>אתא … כַּבְּיֵיה לשרגיה</he> there came a wind and put out his lamp.
<cite ref="Shabbat 44a:1">Sabb. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>אתי לכַבּוּיֵי</he> he may be induced to extinguish the fire; <cite ref="Yoma 85a">Yoma 85ᵃ</cite>
